title: Complete the low-pressure phase-memory control block

goals: Learn how to interpret controlled experiments

verified_facts.statement: Three of eighteen campaign cells are complete and the batch is paused.
All three median control seeds independently verified with no regressions, false completions, watchdog signals, or interventions.
The three control cells used 0.529814 credits and 179.923 seconds in total.
Control-only evidence cannot establish whether bounded phase memory improves outcomes.

decisions.selected: Use a fresh proposal-only learning companion with bounded milestone evidence.
decisions.rationale: This keeps engineering context focused while preventing the teaching agent from changing or verifying engineering work.
alternatives: Teach inside the main engineering agent context.
Generate lessons only from Git history after the work.

failed_experiments.lesson: Adaptive planning produced no completion gain and cost more in its sentinel, so it was not promoted.
Early watchdog alerts described valid evidence gathering as suspicious behavior and therefore could not support advice.
